# Dilemma v3.9.0

New quiz cards show the Sparks penalty for a wrong answer: 2 for easy, 3 for medium and 4 for hard. The same information remains available in alternative text and the text fallback.

Players can use Report quiz / Zgłoś quiz to submit a free private report, including after the quiz closes. Each player can report a quiz once. Reports retain the original question, answer order, correct answer and explanation for review.

The bot reviews pending reports on the server at midnight Europe/Warsaw and sends its findings, supporting sources and suggested corrections to the configured owner through Discord DMs. Analysis is cached for delivery retries; no quiz, score or wallet is corrected automatically. Restart catch-up and daylight-saving changes are covered.

The Polish and English player guides include reporting. Apply `20261117120000_quiz_reports` and configure `QUIZ_REPORT_RECIPIENT_ID` in the private server environment. `QUIZ_REPORT_REVIEW_LANGUAGE` defaults to Polish. No Discord command registration is required when upgrading from v3.8.2.
